title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.32 - Fixes a crash on startup for anyone using Mod Launch Manager. 0.1.31 waited for the other mods to finish loading in a way that never let the game advance a frame under Mod Launch Manager, so the game closed right after the meter loaded. It now waits properly, and modded turrets, runes and powers are named under Mod Launch Manager as they are without it. Verified in game on v0.111.0 with Mod Launch Manager; builds against every version back to v0.107.1.
